tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.24
§ Telem = "oppression"
1) a gatekeeper among the returning exiles in the time of Ezra
2) one of the cities in the extreme south of Judah in the Negeb

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to break up or treat violently; oppression;
